# Third-party Dependencies

## DiffSynth-Studio

Official repository: [modelscope/DiffSynth-Studio](https://github.com/modelscope/DiffSynth-Studio).
Source code is stored in `third_party/DiffSynth-Studio`.

DiffSynth-Studio provides the Wan video pipeline and Wan VACE examples, including
`examples/wanvideo/model_inference/Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B.py`.

This copy contains source code only; it does not install Python packages or
include model weights. Follow the upstream installation and Wan VACE
instructions before running inference.
